evidence.quote: I would like to see progress in lowering inflation resume before we make further adjustments to the target range.
That said, I continue to see greater risks to price stability, especially while the labor market remains near full employment.
Core inflation remains elevated, but my expectation is that it will moderate further this year. Even with this outlook, I continue to see upside risks to inflation.
The U.S. economy remained strong through the end of last year, with solid growth in economic activity and a labor market near full employment.
it seems unlikely that the overall level of interest rates and borrowing costs are exerting meaningful restraint.

parsed.rationale: The monetary-policy portion of the speech is clearly hawkish: it stresses upside inflation risks, strong activity, insufficient policy restraint, and a preference to pause cuts until inflation progress resumes. It still anticipates eventual gradual cuts, and the rest of the speech covers bank regulation, so relevance is medium.
